data.title: Shoreline
data.about:
Shoreline is a prestigious new residential complex on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. Developed by DAMAC Properties, this luxury project features a visionary design that redefines modern living. Enjoy amenities like splash pads, a swim-up bar and yoga deck.

Damac Shoreline at Al Marjan offers 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom apartments with world-class amenities. Nestled on the picturesque Al Marjan Island, Shoreline by DAMAC provides residents with breathtaking views of the sea. You can easily access to key destinations, making it the perfect choice for those seeking luxury and convenience daily. The project is just moments away from Wynn Al Marjan Casino Resort.

characteristics_module.title: An Enviable Lifestyle Awaits You in the Heart of Al Marjan Island.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxury 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with open sea views.
  • Enjoy a luxury island living yet well-connected to the road network.
  • An array of ground floor and outdoor amenities, ranging from a floating bar to an aqua oasis.
  • Discover an active lifestyle with facilities like a gym and running tracks.
  • Explore watersports activities, including surfing, kayaking, jet skiing, windsurfing, and more.
  • Unwind in a relaxing environment with an array of food and drinks on offer at the waterfront bar.

location_tile.title: Unmatched Luxury at Damac Shoreline's Prime Al Marjan Island Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Damac Shoreline enjoys a prime position on the scenic Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The location offers residents breathtaking waterfront views and seamless access to key destinations. Al Marjan Island offers a peaceful ambience and upscale beachfront living at Damac Shoreline.

The apartments are minutes from the iconic Wynn Casino and Al Marjan Island Boulevard. With excellent connectivity, Damac Shoreline ensures residents remain close to the city's vibrant core, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a luxurious and convenient lifestyle.

5 Minutes to Wynn Al Marjan Island
10 Minutes to Al Hamra Mall
15 Minutes to Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club
15 Minutes to Ice Land Water Park
20 Minutes to Ras Al Khaimah Corniche

seo.metaTitle: Shoreline at Al Marjan Island Apartments for Sale
seo.metaDescription: Discover luxurious living at Damac Shoreline, Al Marjan Island. Choose between 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments that offer breathtaking sea views.

more_info.answer: DAMAC Shoreline offers a range of luxurious living options, including 1 to 5-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses. Each residence is designed with elegance and offers stunning open sea views.
more_info.question: What types of residences are available at Shoreline by DAMAC Properties at Al Marjan Island?

more_info.answer: Residents can enjoy a plethora of resort-style amenities such as an infinity pool, sunset bar, Zen garden, gym, spa, floating cabanas, waterfront bars, and dedicated areas for water sports. These facilities are designed to provide relaxation, entertainment, and a holistic living experience.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents expect within the development?

more_info.answer: DAMAC Shoreline is situated on the picturesque Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. Nearby attractions include Al Hamra Mall (10 minutes away), Ice Land Water Park (15 minutes away), Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club (15 minutes away), and the world-renowned Wynn Casino. The development also offers easy access to the Al Marjan Island Beach, which is a short 5-minute drive or a leisurely walk.
more_info.question: Where is DAMAC Shoreline located and what are its nearby attractions?

more_info.answer: The development offers a 70/30 payment plan with an immediate 20% deposit. Subsequent installments are spread over the construction period, with the final 30% due upon completion. The anticipated completion date is July 2028.
